study_sessions.title: study sessions
study_sessions.note: Low-energy, calm or focused tracks with gentle textures suit study sessions; avoid sudden tempo changes.

gym_sessions.title: gym sessions
gym_sessions.note: High-energy tracks with driving tempo and confident or euphoric moods suit workouts.

rainy_afternoons.title: rainy afternoons
rainy_afternoons.note: Soft acoustic textures and relaxed moods fit rainy afternoons and quiet reading.

road_trips.title: road trips
road_trips.note: Steady mid-to-fast tempos and anthemic genres such as rock or synthwave fit long drives.

late_night_wind_down.title: late-night wind-down
late_night_wind_down.note: Very low energy and calm or peaceful moods fit late-night wind-down listening.
